title: Japan urges US to enforce discipline after second Marine arrest

blocks.text: Japan urged the United States to enforce discipline among its troops after a Marine was arrested on suspicion of drink driving during a curfew in the wake of another serviceman's arrest on a murder charge, the defense minister said on Monday.
